dialogues.speaker: Sandrone
dialogues.text: Do you mind if I vent about my colleagues?

response.speaker: Sandrone
response.text: Fantastic. I've always dreamed of a secluded place where I can rant about all the nonsense I have to deal with at work!

response.speaker: Sandrone
response.text: Ugh! Don't even get me started on Dottore. I want him out of my life forever... and everyone else's.

response.speaker: Sandrone
response.text: The Rooster and Regrator might not get along, but their evasive rhetoric and manipulation feel like it comes from the exact same playbook.

response.speaker: Sandrone
response.text: First, they pretend to agree with your ideas. Then, they'll say something that implies, "Of course, you clearly don't mind all the issues this'll cause..." And then they just wait for you to back down.

response.speaker: Sandrone
response.text: But if you don't back down, that's when they pull out the big guns — long, complicated arguments that no one understands, filled with technical terminology and archaic phrases. Then, once they've finished spouting nonsense, they'll ask, "So, what do you think?"

response.speaker: Sandrone
response.text: What do I think about what! Ugh. If you want to show off your vocabulary, why not just hold a spelling bee? I'd rather spend my time actually getting somewhere!

response.speaker: Sandrone
response.text: Ugh... It makes me angry just talking about them!

choices.text: Maybe you should take a break...

response.speaker: Sandrone
response.text: Forget it, forget it... I'm well aware that the principles that govern the real world are not always as clean-cut and absolute as mathematical theorems.

response.speaker: Sandrone
response.text: It's only thanks to The Rooster's wily ways that so many competing interests can be reconciled.

response.speaker: Sandrone
response.text: Regrator might well be full of wicked schemes, but there's no denying his ability to manage Snezhnaya's economy and oversee the Adventurers' Guild.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Is this how venting's supposed to work...?

response.speaker: Sandrone
response.text: Huh? I... I wasn't trying to be nice! Just because I can recognize an objective fact doesn't mean I can't also hate it!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Is there anything else bothering you?

response.speaker: Sandrone
response.text: How about we save it for next time? Berating two people in one day is enough for me. It's important to learn restraint, even when venting.

choices.text: How about a drink of water...
We can talk about anything you like.
